items.title: Arthur "Monk" Hazel Interview, 1967-10-28
items.q: But Pee-wee was, well, he was here for quite a while with Lurie Primer, you know.

ctx.x: In a Mist, and all those kind of things. And he'd sit down and play those. And Pee-wee, Pee-wee has played some wonderful things. Pee-wee, but at one time, he'd play erratic, and another time, he'd play real pretty, and another time, he'd do what Muggsy used to call squawk. Muggsy made a novel one time. And then one tune on there, he'd call it Pee-wee Squawks again. But Pee-wee was, well, he was here for quite a while with Lurie Primer, you know. They went ahead to that place over on Bourbon Street. That's a…
Pee-wee Russell has never been a conventional player.
